ledger_convention.total_atoms: C3H10O3: glycerol + 2 spectator H initially; source coordinate blocks all have this composition plus Cu64
ledger_convention.meaning: Stoichiometric embedding of explicit Fig5A transformations. Assumes H/OH/H2O stay on surface until stated, and a single-site symbol per species solely for formal vacancy accounting. Actual adsorption footprint and coadsorbate free energies are not established.
ledger_convention.vacancies: v0 is initial empty-site count. Printed S6 row20 and row23 have one final * whereas gas product would require two under its own single-site notation; terminal phase/site ambiguity is retained.
ledger_convention.TS_ledger: Same total atoms as adjoining states; during bond change component labels are not unique.
ledger_convention.gaseous_exchange: No H2 uptake, H2O desorption, or PDO desorption correction is added to Fig5A sums.
